matches.rationale: Finding 2 directly identifies that Proposition 2.1's Ext-symmetry holds only for locally-free modules over quotient algebras but is illegitimately extended to arbitrary modules in Eq. (3.2), which is exactly the ground-truth point that Jacobian-type algebras lack the general Ext-symmetry needed for the GLS formula. Findings 4 and 5 trace the same unjustified generalization downstream into Theorem 3.2's proof and its specialization, representing the same underlying defect surfacing at different points (permitted under R3).
